newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aviation unit to offer shares outside China.
newsitem.headline: China Aviation unit to offer shares outside China.

text.p: The Shenzhen branch of the China Aviation Science & Technology Import and Export Co plans to issue 300 million foreign currency shares next year to be listed outside China, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The shares are expected to be listed in the third quarter of 1997 but the firm has yet to decide whether to list them in Tokyo or Hong Kong, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
The timing and pricing of the planned issue have not been set and a chief underwriter has yet to be named, he said.
The firm mainly makes liquid crystal displays, cable television facilities and dry-cleaning equipment.
It is among the 38 mainland Chinese enterprises newly chosen by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for listing on overseas stock markets.

The official said the company, which after the issue would have total share capital of some 500 million shares, was aiming for HK$600-700 million in proceeds from the offer. If the issue succeeeds, the firm plans to channel the funds into its core businesses, he said, but gave no details. The company expects after-tax profits of about 100 million yuan this year against 90 million yuan in 1995.
